basic_info.description: Beautiful Mission Terrace home with immense potential. The gorgeous living room has hardwood floors, hardwood mantel and fireplace with views of the Mission hills.  The dining rooms has a kitchen pass through for entertaining and custom built in cabinetry. The galley style kitchen features a dishwasher, refrigerator, and stove, in addition there is ample storage in the pantry room.  Two large bedrooms, one with a walk in closet frame the back of the home and feature views of the surrounding area.  The garage has room for two cars and has an half bath.  The backyard is private and paved for fun in the sun!   Home is located within minutes of the colleges, BART station, Freeways, restaurants and shopping.
